decisions.reason: As a sheet preparation module that builds directly on the firm’s existing postpress know-how and remained prominently presented on its own page in 2023 and 2024, it fits the firm’s absorptive capacity and likely offers learnable, improvable commercial potential within its automated workflow strategy.

The folding add-on unit is close to the established portfolio, has at least one documented customer application and stayed on the website in 2024, so the firm is likely to retain it as a complementary module it can support and refine with its existing technical and service capabilities.
